# SegmentedControl

A compact segmented control for one in-place choice that applies at once, such as Settings' theme (Dark / Light / Match device).

`TVTracker.SegmentedControl` · Inputs

## Use

```jsx
<TVTracker.SegmentedControl options={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="TVTracker.SegmentedControl" options="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Notes

A small segmented control for one in-place choice that applies at once (Settings' theme). Not for filters: those go in BrowseHeader.
